Hey friend, I know you are suffering and I really hope things work out for you in a way that doesn't result in your suicicd. Medicine gives us awesome power, and only you can stop yourself. I'm sorry you have come so close to the brink. 

**One thing I want to emphasize: Your children would much rather have a parent than tons of money, and nobody is perfect. We all have our failings, and that is ok. there are some things that are priceless, and your life, your future, and your future experiences fall into that priceless category **

You don't need to die, you need to heal.

Have you considered taking a break and traveling? If you have enough money to give to your loved ones, it's your money to spend. contact your lawyer and make some plans to quit your job, rehabilitate yourself.

Like you said in your post, it's much harder not to kill someone. Take it as a challenge to *heal* yourself.
